baseDir.description: Base directory where private keys, certificates and CRLs are placed on the local system

logFilename.description: Filename of the CA log. This file will contain CA events, such as certificate issuance.

caIssuersBaseUrl.description: Base URL for CA Issuers, e.g., where certificates are published.

cRLDistributionPointsBaseUrl.description: Base URL for CRL distribution points, e.g., where CRLs are available.

crlRenewalHours.description: Number of hours the CRL should be valid for, i.e. the difference between thisUpdate and nextUpdate fields
